انتقيت (form VIII)
# اِنْتَقَيْتُ (intaqaytu) /in.ta.qaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# اِنْتَقَيْتَ (intaqayta) /in.ta.qaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# اِنْتَقَيْتِ (intaqayti) /in.ta.qaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# اُنْتُقِيتُ (untuqītu) /un.tu.qiː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
